subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular installer source layout now, and must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a generated or preserved single-file entrypoint?
rationale: This is a broad refactor of a stable setup surface, not a broken behavior report, and current docs, tests, release artifacts, and website sync all assume a directly served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor A Guarded Split
options.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

options.title: Allow Focused Extractions Only
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep Installer Monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to avoid helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor A Guarded Split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer and release-history work gives this person the strongest available routing signal for the installer artifact decision.
